This app needs Bluetooth to find and connect to thermal printers.

Access to your photo library is needed to allow you to easily attach images to your reports and attendance records. This simplifies the process of documenting your work and ensures accurate record-keeping.

To streamline the reporting and attendance process, we need camera access so you can capture photos directly within the app and attach them to your reports. This eliminates the need to switch between apps, saving you time and effort.
Biometric authentication is used to verify your identity before performing sensitive actions such as attendance check-in.
NFC is used to read data from cards you tap, so you can log records without typing them by hand.

Microphone access is required to enable seamless communication and video recording within the app. This feature simplifies the reporting process by allowing you to include audio recordings and video messages directly in your reports.
Allowing access to your location even when the app is in the background enables us to provide accurate tracking and simplify your reporting process.
Access to your location while using the app is needed for accurate tracking and to streamline the reporting process.
For app functionality, and ease of use of the application
Aplikasi memerlukan akses sementara ke lokasi presisi perangkat untuk pencatatan kehadiran dan patroli.
